newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatari emir in U.S. kidney transplant.
newsitem.headline: Qatari emir in U.S. kidney transplant.

text.p: Qatar's controversial ruler has had a kidney transplant in the United States, the official Qatari News Agency (QNA) said on Wednesday.
"The Emiri Court announces that His Highness Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani, the Emir of the country, underwent surgery in the United States last night to implant a kidney," it said.
The news agency said the operation was successful but gave no further details.
Sheikh Hamad, 47, toppled his father Sheikh Khalifa in a bloodless palace coup in June 1995. He has a reputation as a maverick among Gulf Arab leaders for openness towards Iran, Iraq and Israel.

Qatar, a tiny country with one of the highest gross national products per capita in the world, belongs to the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries and also controls the world's third largest natural gas reserves after Russia and Iran.
